import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v,envelope,stream,crypto,datagram,trace

    print(json.dumps(r,indent=1,sort_keys=True))

  datagram(envelope('I',5,b'\x01')+envelope('I',3,b'\x01'),auth=[0,0]),
]
